sections.h: A removal package to suit you

body.p: Our professional removers offer you personalised deals for a move at the best price in Ixelles. With a precise quote, we assess the cost of the work according to your needs. You can add services such as packing your belongings, furniture lift hire or dismantling your furniture. A prior visit allows us to get a clear idea of your needs, so we can estimate the volume to be transported and the staff required to provide you with a tailor-made offer.
> What permit is needed to park a furniture lift?

If you are considering hiring a furniture lift for your move, a parking permit must be requested from the Ixelles municipal administration to reserve a parking space. On the day of the move, our truck can then park easily in front of your old home to bring your belongings down and prepare them for transport.
> What are the advantages of using a furniture lift to move in Ixelles?

A furniture lift is often essential in urban neighbourhoods like Ixelles, where staircases are narrow and buildings are tall. It saves time, avoids damage to your furniture and makes transport safer. Discover our packages.
> When should I contact a removal company?

Allow enough time to plan your whole move without stress. In the Brussels area, and particularly in Ixelles, we recommend booking 2 to 3 months in advance to be sure of getting the date that suits you best.
> Can I move during building work or a renovation?

Yes, you can move even if your future home is being renovated. In that case, we can offer a temporary storage solution for your furniture until the work is finished. Talk to your adviser for the best possible organisation.
> Do you offer removal solutions for businesses?

Yes, our company also supports offices, shops and professional practices with their moves. We adapt our services to guarantee a swift resumption of activity. Each solution takes your technical and logistical constraints into account.
> How do I get an accurate quote for my move in Ixelles?

Simply fill in our online form with the details of your move: volume to be transported, floor, access, whether or not a furniture lift is needed, and so on. You will quickly receive a clear and detailed quote, with no obligation, for Ixelles.
